svg.text: SYNC / ACTIVE DECODE (combinational compares + register stage)
Fig 8 - VGA Timing Generator (640 x 480 @ 60 Hz, 25 MHz pixel enable)
Totals: 800 clocks per line (640 visible + 16 front + 96 sync + 48 back), 525 lines per frame (480 visible + 10 front + 2 sync + 33 back).
h_end also = line tick for the vertical counter (Part B).
advances once per line: line_tick = pix_ce & h_end
v_end: vcnt wraps to 0 on the last line. The mux order matters:
x = hcnt_q, y = vcnt_q while active
Compare inputs: hcnt_q (Part A) and vcnt_q (Part B).
Outputs to the rest of the VGA engine
active / hsync_n / vsync_n registered once (matches pixel pipeline stage 0)
One frame = 800 x 525 pixels x 4 clk (100 MHz / 25 MHz) = 1.68 M clk = 16.8 ms = 59.5 Hz.
